decisions.reason: The extended batch already requires compliance with the Notion brand guidelines. The source adds a content-selection exclusion to the separate source-selection Requirement but does not necessarily change the batch's existing acceptance standard.
The initial three-clip trial was already completed and verified. The source concerns guidelines for subsequent clip creation and does not alter the historical initial-trial requirements.
The instruction to review the guideline material about hooks does not establish a new hook criterion or change the existing requirement that selected moments have effective hooks.
The instruction to review the editing-style guidelines does not specify a changed visual-editing standard, so the existing clean-editing requirement remains valid unchanged.
